plugins.description: Complete 21-phase local business SEO audit system for Claude Code. Project-based audit directory (projects/[business-slug]/). 7 Python automation scripts: site crawler, PDF generator, URL validator, score calculator, status tracker, report compiler, project setup. LOCAL-IMPACT (60-item) + SERP-TRUST (50-item) proprietary scoring with SEO Health Index. 28 auto-activating skills, 43 slash commands, 6 sub-agents. Covers technical SEO, on-page, content strategy, keyword gaps, competitor analysis, GBP, AI visibility (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot), entity optimization, backlinks, voice search, accessibility. NEW: AI content detection & humanization audit (Phase 4a) — 24 AI writing pattern taxonomy based on Wikipedia WikiProject AI Cleanup. PDF reports with SVG gauge charts. 30/90/180/365-day action plans.
